basic_details.job_title: ACMS Administrative Staff Recruitment 2026 - Apply Online for Estate Supervisor and Care Taker Posts

qualification.education_qualification: ESM (JCO) with minimum 20 years of service for Estate Supervisor, ESM (Hav/Nb Sub) with minimum 15 years of service for Care Taker, Medically fit, No disciplinary history
qualification.details: Estate Supervisor: The applicant should be ESM (JCO) with a minimum of 20 years of service. Preference will be given to Corps of Engineer ESM with tenure in MES when served in the Army. The applicant should be medically fit for the job description. Should not have any disciplinary history while in service or otherwise. Care Taker: The applicant should be ESM (Hav/Nb Sub) with a minimum of 15 years of service rendered in the Army. Should not have any disciplinary history while in service or otherwise.

salary_details.pay_scale: Rs 36,500/- pm (Estate Supervisor), Rs 26,300/- pm (Care Taker)

how_to_apply: Candidates who wish to apply for ACMS Various Posts Recruitment 2026 via email should follow the steps below.
Read the official notification carefully before applying.
Prepare your application with complete bio-data including personal details, educational qualifications, and experience.
Attach self-attested copies of all required documents such as educational certificates, experience certificates, ID proof, and recent passport-size photographs.
Clearly mention the post applied for in the subject line of the email.
Send the complete application to the official email address mentioned in the notification.
Ensure the email is sent before the last date: 30-09-2026.
Keep a copy of the sent email for future reference.

content_sections.heading: How to Apply
content_sections.text: Candidates who wish to apply for ACMS Various Posts Recruitment 2026 via email should follow the steps below. Read the official notification carefully before applying. Prepare your application with complete bio-data including personal details, educational qualifications, and experience. Attach self-attested copies of all required documents such as educational certificates, experience certificates, ID proof, and recent passport-size photographs. Clearly mention the post applied for in the subject line of the email. Send the complete application to the official email address mentioned in the notification. Ensure the email is sent before the last date: 30-09-2026. Keep a copy of the sent email for future reference.

faq.question: Q1. What is the last date to apply for ACMS Administrative Staff Recruitment?
faq.answer: The last date to submit your application via email for the ACMS Administrative Staff posts is 30 September 2026. Ensure your application reaches the concerned authority before this deadline.

faq.question: Q2. How many vacancies are available for Administrative Staff at ACMS?
faq.answer: There are a total of 2 vacancies for Administrative Staff posts at the Army College of Medical Sciences (ACMS). These are for the positions of Estate Supervisor and Care Taker.

faq.question: Q3. What is the application mode for ACMS Recruitment 2026?
faq.answer: The application mode for this recruitment is via email. Candidates need to send their applications and required documents to the official email address provided in the notification.

faq.question: Q4. What are the eligibility criteria for the Estate Supervisor post?
faq.answer: For the Estate Supervisor post, applicants must be Ex-Servicemen (JCO) with a minimum of 20 years of service, medically fit, and have no disciplinary history. Preference is given to Corps of Engineer ESM with MES tenure.

faq.question: Q5. What is the salary for the Care Taker position?
faq.answer: The salary for the Care Taker position is Rs 26,300/- per month. This is a contractual role offered by the Army College of Medical Sciences.

faq.question: Q6. Is there any application fee for ACMS Recruitment 2026?
faq.answer: No, there is no application fee for any category (General/OBC, SC/ST) for the ACMS Administrative Staff recruitment. The application is free of cost.

faq.question: Q7. What is the selection process for these posts?
faq.answer: The selection process for the Administrative Staff positions at ACMS will be based on an Interview. Candidates will be shortlisted and called for an interview.

faq.question: Q8. Where is ACMS located?
faq.answer: The Army College of Medical Sciences (ACMS) is located in Delhi Cantt, Delhi, with the pincode 110010.

faq.question: Q9. Can freshers apply for these posts?
faq.answer: No, these posts are specifically for Ex-Servicemen (ESM) with a specified minimum number of years of service. Freshers are not eligible for this recruitment.

faq.question: Q10. What documents are required for the application?
faq.answer: Candidates need to attach self-attested copies of educational certificates, experience certificates, ID proof, and recent passport-size photographs along with their bio-data when applying via email.
